text_blocks.snippet: Mega Zygarde ex is a Fighting-type Basic Pokémon ex card with 310 HP from the Pokémon TCG expansion Perfect Order (released in 2026).
snippet_highlighted_words: Fighting-type Basic Pokémon ex card with 310 HP from the Pokémon TCG expansion Perfect Order

list.snippet: Type & HP: Fighting-type, 310 HP, Weakness to Grass (x2), Retreat Cost of 2.
Gaia Wave ([FFF]): Deals 200 damage. During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks.
Nullifying Zero ([FFFFF]): For each of your opponent's Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, this attack deals 150 damage to that Pokémon (no Weakness or Resistance applied to Benched Pokémon).

Market Pricing: Standard and alternate art versions vary in price, with raw copies of card #120 going for around $42.17 on PriceCharting, while special art/holofoil variants like #124 range from $80 to $110 on TCGplayer.
MSRP: Released on May 22, 2026, for $39.99 to $44.99.
Contents: Includes a foil Mega Zygarde ex promo card, an oversize lenticular promo card, a tech sticker, and 8 booster packs.
